title: Echoes Across the Distance
content:
Two weeks passed.

Thousands of kilometres apart...

Yet somewhere...

Two hearts continued to think about each other.

________________________________________

The sky was covered with soft white clouds.

A cool breeze drifted across the mountaintop.

Siddu and Sneha stood facing each other, their fingers intertwined.

Neither of them spoke.

Their eyes said everything their lips couldn't.

The world around them seemed to disappear.

Only the two of them remained.

Sneha slowly stepped closer.

A gentle smile spread across her face as she wrapped her arms around him.

Siddu froze.

For a brief moment, he didn't know what to do.

His heart wanted to return the embrace...

But his hands hesitated.

Just as he finally began to lift his arms...

Sneha suddenly lost her footing.

"Sneha!"

Her hand slipped from his.

She fell backward toward the edge of the hill.

"No!"

________________________________________

Siddu jolted awake.

His heart pounded violently against his chest.

Drops of sweat covered his forehead.

He looked around the room.

Silence.

It was only a dream.

He took a deep breath and slowly got out of bed.

Walking to the washroom, he splashed cold water on his face before looking into the mirror.

For several seconds...

He simply stared at his own reflection.

Then he quietly whispered,

"Why does it still feel like something is missing?"

It was the same emptiness...

The same unanswered feeling...

That had stayed with him for the last five years.

No success...

No promotion...

No achievement...

Had ever managed to fill it.

________________________________________

After getting ready, Siddu buttoned his crisp white shirt, adjusted his black tie, slipped into his black blazer, and picked up his car keys.

Soon, his car stopped in front of one of France's most prestigious corporate headquarters.

The towering glass building reflected the morning sunlight brilliantly.

As soon as Siddu stepped inside, employees greeted him with respect.

"Good morning, sir."

"Good morning, Mr. Siddhartha."

He acknowledged everyone with a polite smile before entering his cabin.

A few moments later, there was a knock on the door.

"Come in."

A young woman entered with a file in her hands.

She was his personal assistant, Rose.

"Good morning, sir."

"Good morning, Rose."

She placed the file on his desk.

"Sir, the representatives from the Indian company have arrived."

"The meeting is scheduled in thirty minutes."

Siddu nodded.

"Alright."

"Prepare the schedule."

"I'll be there."

"Certainly, sir."

Rose smiled politely before leaving the cabin.

Siddu leaned back in his chair.

For some reason...

The dream refused to leave his mind.

________________________________________

Meanwhile...

Back in India...

Sneha glanced at the calendar.

"Two weeks..."

"By now... they must have met."

The thought alone made her restless.

Questions flooded her mind one after another.

How did Siddu react after seeing Shreya?

Did they talk about the past?

Did Shreya tell him about me?

Will she remember to call me?

What if...

What if they become close again?

Her heart tightened.

She immediately shook her head.

"No."

A small smile appeared on her face.

"Siddu isn't the same person anymore."

"He's grown."

"He's learned from his past."

"He won't lose himself again."

Even after convincing herself...

She couldn't stop looking at her phone.

Hoping...

That at any moment...

It would ring.

And on the other end...

Would be Shreya.
